title: Password Policy Input
description: Stops admins shipping password rules that make accounts weaker by reading the policy back against NIST SP 800-63B-4: it flags banned composition rules, forced rotation, security questions and hints, minimums under 15 (8 with MFA), maximums under 64, blocked paste, no breached-password check and no failed-sign-in limit, shows what the rules do to real passwords (Password1! accepted, a long passphrase refused), and fixes each rule or applies NIST defaults in one tap.
